string.text: Hover a weapon and strip its attachments and parts. Hold mode strips each newly hovered weapon. Works in the stack popup.
When you disassemble a weapon that still has attachments or parts, it strips those instead. Once nothing is left to strip, disassemble works normally.
Move stripped attachments and parts back to the weapon's inventory.
Prevent moving equipped items (PDA, NVG, etc.) into a companion inventory - some can vanish. Loose bag items still move normally.
